filters.description: Filter tree forwarded to the API "filters" body. Use logical groups ("all" = AND, "any" = OR, "not" = negate) containing conditions of the form {"op": <operator>, "field": <field>, "value": <value>}. Operators: eq, in, gt, gte, lt, lte, range (2-element array), contains, isnull. Example: {"all": [{"op": "eq", "field": "trading_status_key", "value": "operating"}, {"op": "gte", "field": "total_funding_usd", "value": 1e8}]}

ordering.description: Field to order by; prefix with "-" for descending.
